name: cs-basics-site
description: GitHub Pages build dependencies for CS_basics

comments.dependencies: Everything build.sh copies into _site/ or renders with. d3 is shipped to the browser as _site/vendor/d3.min.js, so it is a runtime dependency, not a dev one — an `npm ci --omit=dev` install must still be able to build the site.
comments.devDependencies: Test-only. jsdom is used by site/test/*.test.js and never reaches _site/.
